concepts.title: A · 杏橙底 · 温和监督体重
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one original premium mobile app icon concept for a gentle weight-loss accountability app. The product notices meals and progress, checks in, and helps a person keep going without nagging, scolding or body shame. This is accountability, not merely generic companionship. Square 1024 by 1024 actual icon artwork; full-bleed opaque background extending to all four corners; do not pre-round the outside square. One beautifully centered bold compact symbol with approximately 22 percent safe padding. Clean flat vector-like design, smooth intentional curves, strong silhouette, readable at 32 pixels, no 3D, no shadows, no texture, no gradients. No phone mockup, presentation board, text, letters, words, numbers, watermarks, extra decorations, brand references, leaves, muscular bodies or weight-loss before-and-after imagery. This is a NEW design, do not reproduce any previous image.
Color palette: warm soft apricot background #F3BE96, warm ivory #FFF9ED for the main symbol, dark cocoa #503F3C and a tiny coral accent. Primary mark: a friendly but sophisticated rounded bathroom scale, seen straight from above, drawn as one solid ivory softly squared silhouette. Integrate a small clean semicircular analog dial in its upper third and two discreet cocoa dot eyes beneath it, suggesting a kind attentive coach who keeps an eye on your progress. No smiley mouth. The scale must remain unmistakable yet feel welcoming rather than judgmental. The analog dial has a single coral needle, no tick labels or numerals. Elegant optical proportions, not stock clipart, not a toy. Just one symbol.
